title: Saucer Showdown relay
description: saucer.drewburr.com:24680/udp. Provisioned from drewburr-documentation k8s/saucer-showdown; edit there, not in the UI.

panels.title: Up
panels.description: Prometheus can scrape the relay's metrics port.

panels.title: Players (machines)
panels.description: Machines in open rooms, hosts included. Couch players on one machine count once.

panels.title: Seats filled
panels.description: Machines in rooms / machines the open rooms have room for. Shows 'no rooms' when none are open.

targets.expr: sum(relay_room_peers{job="relay-metrics", namespace="saucer-showdown", game=~"$game"}) / sum(relay_room_seats{job="relay-metrics", namespace="saucer-showdown", game=~"$game"})

panels.title: Connections
panels.description: Open connections, in a room or not.

panels.title: Rooms hosted (range)
panels.description: Rooms opened over the dashboard's time range. Includes relay-probe checks unless filtered out with the game variable.

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Since the relay process started. Every counter resets on restart.

panels.title: Protocol
panels.description: Relay protocol version. Game builds speaking a different version are refused (reason=outdated).

panels.title: Players by game
panels.description: Machines in open rooms, hosts included.

panels.title: Capacity used
panels.description: Against the relay's limits (400 rooms, 1024 connections). Across every game.

panels.title: Refusals by reason (per min)
panels.description: no_such_room = wrong code, outdated = old game build, too_many_tries = rate limited (20 wrong codes / address / min), room_full, relay_full, bad_request.

panels.title: Round trip, relay to players
panels.description: Sampled every 10 s for each machine in a room. A player's ping to the host is roughly theirs plus the host's. Gaps = nobody in a room.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, game) (rate(relay_peer_round_trip_seconds_bucket{job="relay-metrics", namespace="saucer-showdown", game=~"$game"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Packet loss to players
panels.description: 0 to 1 per machine, sampled with the round trip. Quantiles are coarse (bucketed).

panels.title: Room length (closed rooms)
panels.description: How long rooms stayed open, over the trailing hour of closed rooms.

panels.title: Room size at peak (closed rooms)
panels.description: Most machines each closed room had at once, host included, over the trailing hour.

panels.title: Network throughput
panels.description: On the wire, ENet overhead included.

panels.title: Network packets
panels.description: ignored = empty, too big, unknown type, or data from outside a room.

panels.title: Game payload by game
panels.description: Game packets taken in to pass on (payload only).

panels.title: Added delay (poll duration)
panels.description: Time per pass over waiting packets; packets wait while one runs, so this is the delay the relay adds. The loop also naps 1 ms (10 ms when idle) between passes.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: Cores in use. relay work = time spent in poll passes.

panels.title: Memory (RSS)
panels.description: Pod memory limit is 256 MiB.
